runConfiguration.backwards_compatibility: Major version bumps allowed where the dependent still builds and runs. A test baseline is measured before any update; a test already failing on the baseline does not block the update, and is reported.

description:
Card #15's first landing fixed 27 of the 28 Dependabot alerts open on 2026-10-10 (specs/1403-dependabot-alert-backlog/spec.md lists each route). #226 remains: braces <= 3.0.3 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, high) has no patched release, and the operator's security_tier forbids dismissing it.

In frontend/ two dependents need braces through micromatch 4, whose latest (4.0.8) still requires it: tailwindcss 3 (directly and through chokidar 3), and eslint-config-next through @next/eslint-plugin-next, which pins fast-glob at exactly 3.3.1 as of 16.4.0. A Tailwind 4 migration removes only the first path, so no upgrade in this repo's control clears #226.

THE WORK, WHEN IT IS RUNNABLE. Check npm view braces versions --json for a release above 3.0.3, or npm view @next/eslint-plugin-next dependencies for a release without fast-glob (and Tailwind 4, card #19, for the other path). With a braces release out, the fix is npm update braces in frontend/ on Node 20, then the frontend checks compared against specs/1403-dependabot-alert-backlog/baseline.md, then make check-security-alerts. Nothing is runnable until one of those releases exists.

WHY IT MATTERS TO THE BOARD. Card #10 left make check-security-alerts non-gating because open alerts would block every push. With #226 the only open alert, the operator can decide on gating with that single known exception in view.
